cohort: 144 preterm infants admitted to the National Institute of Child Health (NICH) in Karachi, Pakistan (93 males and 51 females, mean age 2.34 days).
finding: 37.6% of preterm neonates had IVH, with a significant association between IVH and age, gestational age, birth weight, APGAR scores, place of admission, mode of delivery, need for ventilation, and preterm status.
mod_finding: Mode of delivery was significantly associated with IVH.
gest_age: Preterm (specific gestational ages not mentioned, though a significant mean difference of gestational age was observed between neonates with and without IVH)
birth_weight: Birth weight was significantly associated with IVH
